text:
Alex P: FYI — we hit a blocker on ACMECloud PO provisioning for the EU launch. PO accepted but provisioning hung because billing entity VAT != marketplace vendor VAT and signatory authority differs per region. Also SKU alias routing sent resources to us-east instead of eu-west. Need quick sync before we proceed with the joint announcement.

Maya S: ugh. which PO number? can we patch with a manual mapping? :grimacing:

Alex P: PO# 2026-ACME-4312. marketplace-bot webhook shows 200 -> accepted, but fulfillment API returned 409 conflict: "billing_entity_mismatch". snippet: ```{"po":"2026-ACME-4312","vendor_vat":"FR12345","billing_vat":"DE67890","assigned_region":"eu-west-1","fulfilled_region":"us-east-1"}```

Fred L: tagging legal — if the billing entity and VAT mismatch is unresolved we can't sign off on revenue recognition in EU. Also signatory authority: marketplace expects a local signatory for FR/DE. Do we have delegation docs?

Sophie O: ops checked. The SKU alias table has an old mapping for ACME sku "ACME-EBS-XL" -> alias "ebs-xlarge-us" which routes to us-east ASG. We can temporarily remap, but marketplace will re-sync and clobber changes unless we push a canonical alias back upstream.

Giorgio F: finance — we need VAT alignment before invoicing. We could accept the PO and delay billing to next invoice run, but that breaks marketplace terms. What's the risk of rejecting/returning the PO to buyer?

Maya S: buyer org says they need the deployment live before quarter-end for an internal demo + we promised the joint press sync next week. We can't delay the announcement but also can't violate VAT/regulatory controls.

Fred L: propose immediate short-term path: 1) manual alias override to route to eu-west (ops), 2) sign a temporary delegation letter (legal) that marketplace accepts for FR/DE signatory, 3) finance to create a VAT-side memo and flag invoice as "provisional". All conditional on marketplace confirming acceptance of delegation.

marketplace-bot: automated update — Vendor mapping sync scheduled at 2026-04-03T03:00Z. Any manual changes will be reconciled at that time.

Sophie O: I can do manual override now but need marketplace API token with write mapping scope. @Maya S can you ask the marketplace partner PM for a token or accept a zero-downtime override?

Maya S: pinged partner PM (cc @acmepm). They replied: "we can allow a manual alias for 48h if you submit a signed delegation PDF and a short SOW note." Sending now.

Giorgio F: if legal can produce delegation PDF today, finance can mark invoice provisional and do holdback of tax reconciliation. I need exact wording for the holdback line item. Fred?

Fred L: drafting now. Will attach delegation PDF and a one-paragraph acceptance: "Redwood Inference accepts temporary signatory delegation for PO# 2026-ACME-4312 limited to provisioning actions only; full invoicing and entity transfer contingent on VAT reconciliation."

Alex P: plan: Sophie will override alias and confirm provisioning -> Maya will secure partner approval and relay signed delegation -> Fred will upload delegation to marketplace portal -> Giorgio will flag invoice and create holdback memo -> I will pause joint announcement until I have confirmation provisioning + delegation done. If all green by EOD, we lift hold.

Sophie O: override complete. Provisioning kicked, resources showing in eu-west. Request ID: rsrc-87321.

marketplace-bot: fulfillment update — resources provisioned (rsrc-87321) in eu-west-1 at 2026-04-01T18:23Z.

Maya S: partner confirmed delegation accepted. They asked we submit the SOW note to the partner portal; I've done that.

Giorgio F: invoice flagged provisional, created holdback line "VAT reconciliation pending - holdback 100% of VAT component". Finance ticket FT-8941.

Fred L: delegation PDF uploaded to marketplace portal and signed copy saved to /legal/marketplace/delegations/2026-ACME-4312.pdf.

Alex P: OK — all checkboxes ticked. Joint announcement still on pause until tomorrow morning to give legal/finance an overnight audit. If nothing pops, go/no-go call 09:00 CET. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
